chunks: That the angels, when they hear the adhan from the people of the earth, say: 'These are the voices of the Ummah of Muhammad, peace be upon him and his family, proclaiming the tawhid of Allah.' So they seek forgiveness from Allah for the Ummah of Muhammad, peace be upon him and his family, until they finish that salat.

key_terms.أُمَّةِ مُحَمَّدٍ: the community of Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.الصَّلَاةِ: the prayer whose duration marks the period of the angels' istighfar
key_terms.الْأَذَانَ: the call to prayer raised by the people of the earth
key_terms.الْمَلَائِكَةَ: the angels who hear the call and respond with seeking forgiveness
key_terms.بِتَوْحِيدِ اللَّهِ: with the declaration of Allah's divine unity
key_terms.فَيَسْتَغْفِرُونَ: they seek forgiveness on behalf of the believers

ai.seo_question: What happens when the angels hear the adhan from the people of the earth?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the spiritual effect of the adhan, portraying it as a proclamation of tawhid heard by the angels. It also emphasizes the honor of the Ummah of Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله and the mercy of Allah, as the angels seek forgiveness for them until the salat is completed.
